item.title: NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026: AI, Robotics & Industry Shift
item.description: Jensen Huang’s GTC Berlin keynote unveils NVIDIA’s DSX POD, Open Shell AI agents, open models, and a robotics push, reshaping Europe’s AI landscape.

item.title: NVIDIA Open Models Power Sovereign AI Across Industries
item.description: NVIDIA releases open‑source models for language, robotics, biology and quantum computing, enabling sovereign AI deployment across infrastructure worldwide.

item.title: NVIDIA Agent Toolkit: Grounding Enterprise AI
item.description: Explore NVIDIA’s expanded Agent Toolkit, its new grounding tools, enterprise use cases, and how it reshapes secure, data‑centric AI across industries.

item.title: NVIDIA Expands Confidential Computing for Secure AI
item.description: NVIDIA adds Open Shell, Confidential Bare Metal, containers and VMs, letting AI developers protect models and data on cloud and on‑prem hardware.

item.title: NVIDIA cuDSS GA: GPU‑Accelerated Simulations Engineers
item.description: Explore NVIDIA’s cuDSS GA, its industry‑wide performance gains, integration with top simulation tools, and future impact on engineering workflows.

item.title: European Factories Go AI‑First with NVIDIA Stack
item.description: NVIDIA’s CUDA‑X, Omniverse, Cosmos and FOX let European manufacturers launch AI agents, digital twins and simulations for smarter, faster production.

item.title: NVIDIA Cloud Partners Scale EU AI Infrastructure
item.description: Explore how NVIDIA’s Cloud Partners are expanding sovereign AI clouds across Europe, Africa, and Central Asia, boosting secure, open AI workloads.

item.title: Google Cloud & NVIDIA Launch A5X Vera Rubin Instances
item.description: Google Cloud and NVIDIA debut A5X Vera Rubin instances, pairing compute, high‑bandwidth networking and liquid‑cooling for reinforcement learning and secure AI.

item.title: NVIDIA GTC Berlin: RTX Spark & DGX Spark Unveiled
item.description: Explore NVIDIA’s local AI hardware unveiled at GTC Berlin, from RTX Spark’s personal power to DGX Spark’s enterprise scaling and new model integrations.

item.title: Nvidia's Plug‑In AI Centers & Robotics for Europe
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang outlines Europe’s AI future with modular DSX Pods, Vera Rubin racks, Agile One robots, and open‑source models for Europe.

item.title: NVIDIA's AI Factories: Maximizing ROI Through Innovation
item.description: NVIDIA redefines AI infrastructure with 'AI Factories,' focusing on productivity, durability, and fungibility to ensure sustainable ROI.

item.title: Open vs Closed AI: Nvidia’s Playbook for Startup Success
item.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, Nvidia leaders dissect the open‑source vs AI dilemma, revealing cost, speed, and control trade‑offs for startups.

item.title: NVIDIA Local AI: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning & Open‑Source
item.description: NVIDIA unveils Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B MoE model, and NeMo Switchyard, boosting local AI performance while expanding open‑source ecosystems.

item.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning & Switchyard: Faster Agentic AI
item.description: NVIDIA expands its Nemotron line with the 30B‑parameter Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and introduces NeMo Switchyard, an open‑source routing library that boosts agentic AI efficiency.

item.title: Firebird Unveils CIS’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia
item.description: Firebird’s new AI factory in Armenia, powered by NVIDIA and Dell, brings 300 MW of compute, 70k+ GPUs and a 2‑GW roadmap to the CIS region by 2027.

item.title: South Korea Charts AI Future with NVIDIA Alliance
item.description: President Jae Myung Lee and Korean CEOs met NVIDIA at the AI Summit, unveiling a KAIST joint lab and new SK memory ties, positioning Korea as an AI hub.

item.title: BMS Unleashes AI Super POD: Transforming Drug Discovery
item.description: Bristol Myers Squibb deploys an NVIDIA DGX Super POD, a Vera Rubin AI factory that gives every scientist limitless compute to accelerate drug discovery.

item.title: Infinity Raises $15M to Break Nvidia's AI Monopoly
item.description: Inference startup Infinity raises $15M to automate low_level code for AI chips, challenging Nvidia's CUDA dominance with its Ignition agent.
